info.title: XOS Public API
info.summary: One API for Atlas, Gateway, Compass, SDKs and third parties.
info.description: Versioned REST API for XOS 4.0 (Section 10.1, ADR 0003). Cursor pagination with `limit` and `cursor`; sparse fieldsets with `fields`; filters with `filter[field][op]=value`; `Idempotency-Key` on every POST; `ETag` and `If-Match` on updates; RFC 9457 problem details; refusals as 422 with `refusal` set to NO_ANSWER, UNRATIFIED or REFUSE. Money is integer minor units with a currency; null is unpriced, never zero. Restricted fields the caller may not read stay present as `{ "masked": true, "reason": "..." }`. The active organization is bound to the credential.

bearerJwt.description: Short-lived Supabase session JWT for Atlas, Gateway and Compass. The active organization is the one chosen in the context switcher.

apiKey.description: Org-scoped API key for servers, sent as `Authorization: Bearer xos_live_...`. Keys are hashed, capability-scoped and expiring.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state, such as an Idempotency-Key reused with a different body.
